WELCOME TO YOUR WORKSHOP

Start with a little curiosity.

01 · ExploreClick an object in the house, or choose a room to discover its vocabulary.

02 · ListenHear the word, slow it down, or listen to a complete example. Choose US or UK English in the top bar.

03 · Keep itSave a word to your collection. Mark it learned when you feel confident.

04 · PracticeUse flashcards, meaning quizzes, and listening challenges. Filter by a trade or practice your saved words.

Audio uses the English voices available on your browser and device. A preferred accent is used when installed. The pronunciation guide shows a common US pronunciation. Progress stays in this browser; export a backup from My collection.
